observations.contract: Pauldron design association and local admission
observations.trace: Original Adler348 and Lens12 delegate732 independently flagged that DevicePauldronCarrier::record validates one design while public record_plates accepts another without validation or retained association. Current PauldronDesign valid_shape admits arm length65..125mm, upper lames1..3 and lower lames3..7; on the selected validated route the lower-lame follow product is at most7000, below u16 maximum. The current plain limb generator and fitted creator pass the same design to both stages. A hypothetical direct public caller can instead supply valid default design A with 2mm gauge to record and separately pass valid design B with 3mm gauge to record_plates, or pass B with arm_length0 even though that fails normal admission. With a nonzero lower-lame count, the latter source expression includes 0.004 divided by zero. An unchecked lower_lames66 also reaches a u16 product1000*66 above65535 if prior recording/layout work succeeds.
observations.remaining: Neither design, division, loop, allocation, kernel, caller nor device ran. The invalid-input examples are possible at the public source boundary, not claims about selected callers; compile/profile behavior and downstream error or geometry remain unobserved. The two design references need an explicit ownership/admission policy.

observations.trace: FORM writes STATUS_INVALID_SURFACE to carrier.status and returns when length(fit.y.xz)<0.01. PartFrame::validate permits finite orthonormal identity axes with positive extents, and frame_words/frame_at map its y axis to [0,1,0], whose xz length is zero. DevicePauldronCarrier::record_plates uses the carrier frame_points but does not combine carrier.status into the new DevicePart status. Public record_limb_armor returns only that DevicePart for Pauldron, discarding its carrier handle. By contrast generate_limb_armor_on reads carrier.status separately and the fitted creator records a COPY_STATUS atomic OR into part.status.
observations.remaining: This is a source-derived conditional failure-propagation question. No frame, shader, status, GPU operation or readback ran; a later part or normal check might still reject the result, and no successful invalid mesh or actual creator failure is claimed. The ordinary generator and fitted creator paths have explicit separate status handling.

observations.trace: PartLayout::push takes ShellPlan sources.len() as u32 and adds carrier_count and final_count without checked arithmetic; ShellPlan stores at least outer and inner source per carrier, while source encoding reserves bit31 for the inner wall. Mathematically, two hypothetical accepted shells with 2^30 carriers each need at least2^32 final sources, exceeding the u32 final count, before any further packed-index alias analysis. The native shader later tests the same bit to select an inner wall.
observations.remaining: No giant shell, arithmetic operation, allocation, shader or device ran. Real producer, memory and GPU limits may reject or prevent the hypothetical before this point; actual profile overflow behavior and supported reachability remain open. This is a remaining capacity contract, not a demonstrated normal input failure.

observations.contract: Current textile additions and mixed append
observations.trace: Current PartBuild carries optional textile coordinates, maps final sources to their carrier UVs when finishing, and BuiltPart::append pads missing UVs with zero when one side has a chart. Source inspection covers the selected dataflow; original6533 had no corresponding optional field.
observations.remaining: Valid coordinate cardinality, producer guarantees, public arbitrary BuiltPart admission, all append consumers, skin correspondence and native execution remain open; current additions are not credited to original historical reviewers.
